rows.Definition: You control the channel, the rules, the audience relationship, and the data.
rows.Characteristics:
You set the rules
You own the audience relationship
You own the data
You can change format, frequency, and message freely
Distribution is not gated by an algorithm or editor
Compounding: content stays, SEO builds, list grows
Slow to build, hard to kill
rows.Examples:
Website and blog
Email list
App and in-app surfaces
Docs and help center
Community you host (Discord, forum)
Podcast you produce
YouTube channel you run
Social profiles you manage (partially owned)
Webinars you host
Events you run
Packaging, receipts, invoices
rows.Strengths:
Full control
Full data
Compounding returns
No gatekeeper
Direct relationship
Cheapest at scale
rows.Weaknesses:
Slow to build
Requires ongoing investment
No borrowed audience
Ceiling = your existing reach
Easy to become an echo chamber
rows.Subtypes:
Fully owned: website, email, app, docs
Partially owned: social profiles (you own the account, platform owns the audience and rules)
Leased-owned: newsletter on Substack, store on Shopify, app on App Store
rows.Key risk: Platform dependency. You “own” your YouTube channel until YouTube changes the algorithm or bans you.

rows.Definition: You don't control the channel. You earn placement through merit, relationships, or newsworthiness.
rows.Characteristics:
Third party controls the channel and rules
You can influence but not dictate
No direct payment (or payment is indirect)
High trust with audience
Hard to scale, hard to predict
Can vanish overnight
rows.Examples:
Press coverage
Journalist mentions
Podcast guesting
Guest posts
Interviews
Backlinks
Reviews (G2, Capterra, Trustpilot, App Store)
Word of mouth
Shares and reposts by users
Community mentions
Wikipedia / directory listings
Awards
Conference talks
Analyst reports
SEO organic rankings (earned-ish)
LLM citations and AI overviews (new earned surface)
rows.Strengths:
Highest trust
Third-party credibility
Free or low cost
SEO and AI citation value
Social proof
rows.Weaknesses:
No control
No guarantee
Hard to measure
Hard to scale
One negative review can outweigh ten positive
Journalist/editor gatekeeping
rows.Subtypes:
Pure earned: organic word of mouth, unsolicited shares
Influenced earned: PR outreach, guest posts, review requests
Algorithmic earned: SEO, social algorithm reach, AI citations
rows.Key risk: You can't turn it on. You can only make it more likely.

rows.Definition: You pay for placement, reach, or audience access. You rent the channel.
rows.Characteristics:
Platform or publisher controls the channel
You control targeting, creative, budget, timing
You don't own the audience or the data (mostly)
Instant on, instant off
Scales with money
Costs rise with competition
Measurement is platform-biased
rows.Examples:
Search ads (Google, Bing)
Social ads (Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, X)
Display and programmatic
Native ads
Video ads (YouTube, CTV, OTT)
Podcast ads
Newsletter sponsorships
Influencer sponsorships
Affiliate (performance-based)
Sponsorships (events, communities)
Direct mail
Billboard / OOH
Print, radio, TV
Retail media (Amazon, Walmart)
rows.Strengths:
Instant reach
Precise targeting
Full control of creative and message
Scales with budget
Measurable (to a point)
Good for testing messages fast
rows.Weaknesses:
Stops when spend stops
Costs rise over time
No compounding
Ad fatigue
Platform risk and policy changes
Privacy and tracking limits
Audience isn't yours
CAC can exceed LTV
rows.Subtypes:
Auction paid: search, social, display (bid-based)
Fixed paid: sponsorships, placements (negotiated)
Performance paid: affiliate, CPA, rev-share
Rented audience: influencer, newsletter sponsorship
rows.Key risk: You're renting. Stop paying, stop reaching.

rows.Definition: Co-controlled. You and another party both have a stake.
rows.Characteristics:
Shared control, shared audience, shared risk
Negotiated rules
Often hybrid owned/earned/paid
Leverages partner trust
Complex to manage
Attribution is messy
rows.Examples:
Co-marketing campaigns
Co-branded webinars
Co-authored research
Partner newsletters
Integration directories
Marketplace listings
App store listings
Affiliate networks
Referral programs
Bundles
Joint events
Reseller / channel partners
Employee advocacy (shared between brand and employee)
rows.Strengths:
Borrowed trust
Borrowed audience
Shared cost
Shared risk
Access to new segments
Stronger proof (two brands)
rows.Weaknesses:
Slower to execute
Split control
Brand dilution risk
Attribution confusion
Partner dependency
Misaligned incentives
rows.Subtypes:
Peer shared: two equal brands
Platform shared: you + marketplace/app store
Employee shared: brand + employee voice
Customer shared: brand + customer story
rows.Key risk: Partner owns the relationship more than you do.

sheets.name: Audiences
sheets.title: Audiences
sheets.description: Who a content unit is for: one audience group (relationship to the company) in one buying role (part in the decision).

rows.Definition: People or organisations that may become customers; uses or will use the product.
People or organisations that may become customers; advocates for adoption and helps move the purchase forward.
People or organisations that may become customers; has authority to approve the purchase.
People or organisations that may become customers; can oppose or prevent adoption.
People or organisations that have purchased the product; uses or will use the product.
People or organisations that have purchased the product; advocates for adoption and helps move the purchase forward.
People or organisations that have purchased the product; has authority to approve the purchase.
People or organisations that have purchased the product; can oppose or prevent adoption.
External parties collaborating on creation, integration or distribution; uses or will use the product.
External parties collaborating on creation, integration or distribution; advocates for adoption and helps move the purchase forward.
External parties collaborating on creation, integration or distribution; has authority to approve the purchase.
External parties collaborating on creation, integration or distribution; can oppose or prevent adoption.
Internal team members; uses or will use the product.
Internal team members; advocates for adoption and helps move the purchase forward.
Internal team members; has authority to approve the purchase.
Internal team members; can oppose or prevent adoption.
Unique people or accounts exposed to the content within a defined period.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of distinct people or accounts with at least one exposure in the period.

rows.Definition: Number of times the content was displayed, including repeat displays.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Sum of displays in the period; not de-duplicated.

rows.Definition: Share of video views that reach the end.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Completed views ÷ video views × 100.

rows.Definition: Change in awareness or recall among exposed people compared with a baseline or control group.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: % aware among exposed − % aware in the control group, from a survey.

rows.Definition: Visits to the pages that carry the content unit.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of sessions on the content unit's pages in the period.

rows.Definition: Visits arriving from unpaid search results.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of sessions with organic search as the source in the period.

rows.Definition: Average page time recorded by analytics. It is not necessarily reading time.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Total recorded time on page ÷ page views with a recorded time.

rows.Definition: New subscribers gained in a period.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of new confirmed subscriptions in the period.

rows.Definition: Share of exposures that produce an interaction (like, reply, share or save).
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Interactions ÷ impressions × 100. State the denominator if views or reach are used instead.

rows.Definition: Gated or package downloads completed.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of completed downloads in the period.

rows.Definition: Event or webinar sign-ups.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of completed registrations in the period.

rows.Definition: Leads that meet the marketing-qualification criteria.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of leads that meet the stated MQL criteria in the period. Reference the criteria used.

rows.Definition: Contacts captured.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of new contacts with usable contact details captured in the period.

rows.Definition: Requests for a product demo.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of submitted demo requests in the period.

rows.Definition: New trials started.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of new trials started in the period.

rows.Definition: Leads accepted by sales as qualified.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of leads that meet the stated SQL criteria and are accepted by sales in the period. Reference the criteria used.

rows.Definition: Share of eligible people who complete a defined event or move to a defined next stage.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: People who complete the named event ÷ people eligible for it × 100. Name the event and the denominator each time, for example trial-to-paid conversion rate.

rows.Definition: Share of opportunities that end as won.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Opportunities won ÷ opportunities closed (won + lost) × 100.

rows.Definition: Cost to acquire a customer.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Acquisition cost (sales and marketing) in the period ÷ new customers acquired in the period.

rows.Definition: Money earned from sales in a period, whatever its source.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Sum of revenue recognised in the period.

rows.Definition: Revenue credited to a content unit by a stated attribution rule.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Revenue from conversions credited to the content unit under the attribution model in use (see the Matrix Attribution model).

rows.Definition: Share of started checkouts that are completed.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Completed checkouts ÷ started checkouts × 100.

rows.Definition: Share of started checkouts that are abandoned.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Abandoned checkouts ÷ started checkouts × 100.

rows.Definition: Share of new users who reach first value.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: New users who reach the defined activation event within the set window ÷ new users × 100.

rows.Definition: Time from sign-up to first value.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Median time from sign-up to the activation event.

rows.Definition: Share of users who complete setup.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Users who complete the setup steps ÷ users who start setup × 100.

rows.Definition: How often monthly users are active on a given day.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Average daily active users in a month ÷ monthly active users in the same month.

rows.Definition: Share of customers lost in a period.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Customers lost in the period ÷ customers at the start of the period × 100.

rows.Definition: Share of recurring revenue lost in a period.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Recurring revenue lost to cancellations and downgrades ÷ recurring revenue at the start of the period × 100.

rows.Definition: Share of customers kept over a period.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: (Customers at end of period − new customers acquired in the period) ÷ customers at start of period × 100.

rows.Definition: Share of a user cohort still active after a period.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Cohort users active in period n ÷ cohort users × 100. State the cohort and the period.

rows.Definition: Cohort retention shown over successive periods.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: For each cohort: active users in each period after the start ÷ cohort size, plotted by period.

rows.Definition: Added monthly recurring revenue from existing customers.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Increase in MRR from upgrades, extra seats and add-ons by existing customers in the period.

rows.Definition: Average revenue per user.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Revenue in the period ÷ active users in the period.

rows.Definition: Net revenue retention: recurring revenue kept from a customer group after expansion, contraction and churn.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: (Starting MRR + expansion − contraction − churn) ÷ starting MRR × 100, for customers present at the start.

rows.Definition: Share of customers who refer.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Customers who make at least one referral in the period ÷ active customers × 100.

rows.Definition: Reviews posted.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of new reviews posted in the period.

rows.Definition: Net Promoter Score.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: % promoters (scores 9–10) − % detractors (scores 0–6) among survey respondents.

rows.Definition: Revenue from customers referred by or led by advocates.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Revenue in the period from customers whose source is an advocate referral.

rows.Definition: Share of dormant users who return.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Dormant users who return in the period ÷ dormant users at the start of the period × 100.

rows.Definition: Revenue from reactivated users.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Revenue in the period from users who were reactivated.

rows.Definition: GitHub stars.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of repository stars at a date, or gained in the period.

rows.Definition: Plugin or package installs.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of installs in the period.

rows.Definition: Replies to outreach messages.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of replies to direct outreach in the period.

rows.Definition: Times cited in AI answers.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of sampled AI answers that cite the content in the period.

rows.Definition: Unpaid third-party references to the brand, product or a named spokesperson.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of distinct third-party items (article, post, thread, episode) published in the period that name the brand, product or spokesperson. Excludes paid, sponsored, affiliate and employee-posted items and the company's own accounts. An item counts once however often it is reposted. Period: calendar month unless stated.

rows.Definition: People who joined an event or webinar live.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of distinct registrants who joined the live session for at least the stated minimum time (default 10 minutes). Replay views are not counted. Attendance rate = Attendance ÷ Registrations for the same event.

rows.Definition: Share of impressions that produce a click.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Clicks ÷ impressions for the same content unit and period, using the platform's own definition of a click and an impression for both. For email, SMS and push, impressions are messages delivered. State whether clicks are all link clicks or unique clicks.

rows.Definition: Average revenue per completed order.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Revenue from completed orders ÷ number of completed orders in the same period. State what is excluded; default: excludes tax and shipping, before refunds.

rows.Definition: Share of customers who buy again within a defined window.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Customers with at least two completed orders within the window ÷ customers with at least one completed order in the cohort. State the cohort period and the window (default: customers whose first order was in a quarter; window 12 months from the first order).

rows.Definition: Support contacts about an order after it was placed.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of support contacts (ticket, chat, call or email) that name an order and are opened within the stated window after the order is placed (default 14 days). A contact thread counts once. Excludes contacts before ordering and sales enquiries.

rows.Definition: Share of orders that lead to a support contact.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Orders with at least one post-order support contact within the window ÷ orders placed in the same cohort period (default window 14 days). Compare with a baseline period or a control group; contacts that did not happen cannot be counted.

rows.Definition: Share of help visits that end without a support contact.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Help-center or docs sessions with no support contact (ticket, chat or call) opened by the same visitor within 24 hours ÷ all help-center or docs sessions in the period. A proxy: a visitor who did not contact support may also have given up.

rows.Definition: Public posts by customers that show or mention the product.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of public posts, photos or videos in the period created by customers (not employees, affiliates, ambassadors or paid creators) that carry the brand tag or hashtag or show or name the product. Reposts by the brand are not counted. A post counts once.

rows.Definition: Customers who have approved the use of their name or story.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of customers, at the end of the period, with a current written approval to be used as a reference (case study, quote, logo or reference call). Withdrawn or expired approvals are not counted. Different from Reference calls completed.

rows.Definition: Calls held between a prospect and a customer reference.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of calls in the period in which a prospect spoke with a customer reference as part of an opportunity. Calls scheduled but not held are not counted.

rows.Definition: Community members who took part in the period.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of distinct members of a community who posted, replied or reacted in the period. Members only; staff accounts are excluded.

rows.Definition: Share of voice queries that receive a complete answer.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Voice queries answered in full ÷ voice queries received, in the same period. A fallback ("I can't help with that") is not an answer.

rows.Definition: Answers given to questions on a Q&A or forum surface.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of answers posted in the period to questions on the surface. State the author type (customers, staff); an answer counts once.

rows.Definition: Job applications received.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of completed applications submitted in the period.

rows.Definition: Published assets that reuse an item.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of distinct published assets (pages, decks, posts) in the period that include the item, such as a customer quote.

rows.Definition: Works made by audience members from the content.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of public works in the period (fan art, remixes, duets, stitches) made by audience members who are not employees, affiliates or paid creators. A work counts once.

rows.Definition: Share of audio plays that reach the end.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Audio plays that reach the end (or the stated percentage, e.g. 90%) ÷ audio plays started, in the same period.

rows.Definition: Share of contacts resolved by an automated channel without a person.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Contacts handled by an automated channel (phone menu, bot) that end without transfer to a person ÷ contacts handled by that channel, in the same period.

rows.Definition: Mean star rating of reviews.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Sum of star ratings ÷ number of ratings posted in the period on the stated site, on the site's own scale (state the scale).

rows.Definition: Mean position of target pages in search results for target queries.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Impression-weighted mean position of the target pages for the stated queries, from the search engine's own report, over the period.

rows.Definition: Links from other sites to a page.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of distinct external pages that link to the page, measured at the end of the period with one stated tool.

rows.Definition: Share of abandoned carts that are later completed.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Abandoned carts completed as orders within the stated window (default 7 days) ÷ abandoned carts in the same period.

rows.Definition: Clicks on a stated link or call to action.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of clicks in the period on the link or button named (for example the demo button); state whether clicks are all or unique.

rows.Definition: Times a code repository was cloned.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of clone operations on the repository in the period, as reported by the code host.

rows.Definition: Unique codes used to claim an offer or sign up.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of orders or sign-ups in the period that used a code issued by the content unit. A code counts once per order.

rows.Definition: Public comments on content.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of public comments posted in the period on the content; deleted and spam comments are not counted.

rows.Definition: Change in conversion rate caused by exposure.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: (Conversion rate of the exposed group − conversion rate of a matched control group) ÷ conversion rate of the control group, over the same period.

rows.Definition: Completed defined events.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of completions in the period of one stated event (for example a purchase or a sign-up). Use Conversion rate when a denominator is needed.

rows.Definition: Cost of each completed acquisition event.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Spend on the content unit ÷ number of acquisition events (state the event: lead, sign-up, purchase) credited to it, in the same period.

rows.Definition: Cost of each app install.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Spend on the content unit ÷ app installs credited to it, in the same period.

rows.Definition: Learners who finish a course or certification.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of learners who completed all required parts of the course or passed the certification in the period.

rows.Definition: Cost per thousand impressions.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Spend ÷ (impressions ÷ 1,000), for the same content unit and period.

rows.Definition: Share of sent messages that are delivered.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Messages delivered ÷ messages sent in the same period; bounced and blocked messages are not delivered.

rows.Definition: Share of employees who take part in an internal program.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Employees who took the stated action (shared, replied, attended) in the period ÷ employees invited.

rows.Definition: Time people actively spend with the content.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Mean time per visit in which the content is in the foreground and the person scrolls, clicks or types, from the analytics tool, over the period.

rows.Definition: Share of users who recover from an error and finish the task.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Users who complete the task within the stated time after seeing the error message ÷ users who saw the error message, in the same period.

rows.Definition: Share of active users who use a feature.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Active users who used the feature at least once in the period ÷ active users in the same period.

rows.Definition: People entering or passing a physical location.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of people counted at the location in the period by the stated method (sensor, tally, scan).

rows.Definition: Times a code repository was forked.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of forks of the repository at the end of the period, as reported by the code host.

rows.Definition: Unsolicited direct messages received.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of direct messages received in the period that were not replies to outreach.

rows.Definition: Share of started quizzes, assessments or tools that are finished.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Sessions that reach the final step ÷ sessions that answered the first question or step, in the same period.

rows.Definition: Quizzes, assessments or tools finished.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of sessions in the period that reached the final step.

rows.Definition: People who watch a live stream.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of distinct viewers who watched the live stream for at least the stated minimum time (default 1 minute) while it was live. No registration is required, unlike Attendance.

rows.Definition: Meetings scheduled with a person at the company.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of meetings confirmed for a future date in the period that a content unit or conversation directly led to; cancelled meetings are not counted.

rows.Definition: Share of delivered messages that are opened.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Messages opened ÷ messages delivered in the same period. Open tracking is blocked by some clients; read it as a trend, not an exact rate.

rows.Definition: Completed orders.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of orders paid or confirmed in the period, whatever their value.

rows.Definition: Leads that come from a partner activity.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Leads captured in the period through a joint or partner activity under a lead-sharing agreement; a lead counts for the partner that supplied it.

rows.Definition: Revenue from customers brought by partners.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Revenue in the period from customers whose first contact was a partner referral or partner activity, under the stated attribution rule.

rows.Definition: Value of open opportunities that content touched.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Sum of the value of open opportunities in the period in which a contact engaged with the content before the opportunity was created or advanced, under the stated attribution rule.

rows.Definition: Share of loaded players that start playback.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Playbacks started ÷ player loads (page views with the player), in the same period.

rows.Definition: Playbacks or sessions started.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of times a media item or game was started in the period; a replay counts as a new play.

rows.Definition: Questions submitted to a session or thread.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of distinct questions submitted by attendees or members in the period.

rows.Definition: Requests for a quote.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of completed quote requests in the period.

rows.Definition: Share of exposed people who recall the brand or message.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Exposed survey respondents who correctly recall the brand or message when asked ÷ exposed survey respondents, in the same survey wave.

rows.Definition: Visits from links on other sites.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of sessions in the period whose source is a link on another site (excluding search engines and paid placements).

rows.Definition: Distinct sites that link to a page or site.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of distinct domains with at least one live link to the page or site at the end of the period.

rows.Definition: Share of people reached who respond.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: People who responded through the named response route (call, scan, reply, code) ÷ people reached by the content unit, in the same period. State the route and the population.

rows.Definition: Time to the first reply.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Median time from a person's message to the first reply from the company, in the period.

rows.Definition: Return on ad spend.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Revenue credited to the ads under the stated attribution rule ÷ ad spend, in the same period.

rows.Definition: Times content is saved or bookmarked.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of saves in the period on the platform's own save feature.

rows.Definition: Scans of a printed code.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of scans of the code in the period, from the code's redirect log.

rows.Definition: Share of searches that end in a useful result.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Searches followed by a click on a result within the session ÷ searches, in the same period; searches with no result count as unsuccessful.

rows.Definition: Times content is shared or reposted.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of shares and reposts by others in the period on the platform's own share feature.

rows.Definition: Share of users who finish a task they started.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Users who complete the stated task ÷ users who started it, in the same period.

rows.Definition: Time from incident start to the first public update.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Median minutes from the confirmed start of an incident to the first public status update, across incidents in the period.

rows.Definition: Time from sending a document to its signature.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Median days from the document being sent to the final signature, across documents signed in the period.

rows.Definition: Times a tool, template or asset is used.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of uses in the period (for example calculator runs, template copies, sticker sends).

rows.Definition: Share of impressions that become views.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Views (by the platform's view definition) ÷ impressions, in the same period.

rows.Definition: Conversions by people who saw but did not click.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Conversions in the period by people who saw the content unit and did not click, within the stated window (default 7 days).

rows.Definition: Counted views of a video or page.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Count of views in the period by the platform's own view definition (state it).

rows.Definition: Total time spent watching.
rows.Calculation / counting rule: Sum of minutes watched in the period, from the platform.
